Playbook:
Description: When ``command not found`` (exit 127) or a scanner/http tool is missing, use an installed alternative or a portable bash/python recipe. Check with ``command -v TOOL`` before relying on a package. Do not repeat the same missing command.
Fallbacks by primary tool:
nmap: - Try ``rustscan`` or ``masscan`` if present. - Bash TCP: ``for p in 22 80 443 8080; do (echo > /dev/tcp/HOST/$p) >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo "$p open"; done`` - Python socket sweep on common ports. - ``nc -zv HOST 1-1024 2>&1 | grep -i succeeded``
gobuster: - ``ffuf -w WORDLIST -u http://HOST/FUZZ`` or ``feroxbuster -u http://HOST`` - ``dirb http://HOST WORDLIST`` or ``wfuzz`` - curl loop over a wordlist for non-404 responses.
ffuf: - ``gobuster dir -u http://HOST -w WORDLIST`` or ``feroxbuster`` - curl wordlist loop (see gobuster).
curl: - ``wget -qO- URL`` or ``wget -O FILE URL`` - Bash ``/dev/tcp`` for simple HTTP - Python ``urllib.request.urlopen``
wget: - ``curl -s URL`` or ``curl -O URL`` - Python urllib.
nc / netcat: - ``ncat``, ``socat``, or bash ``/dev/tcp``.
dig: - ``nslookup HOST``, ``host HOST``, or python ``socket.gethostbyname``.
nslookup: - ``dig HOST``, ``host HOST``, or python socket.
python / python3: - Try the other binary or ``python3.x``.
ss: - ``netstat -tulpn`` or read ``/proc/net/tcp``.
netstat: - ``ss -tulpn`` or ``/proc/net/tcp``.
ip: - ``ifconfig -a`` and ``route -n``.
file: - ``xxd -l 64 PATH``, ``hexdump -C -n 64 PATH`` - Python: read first bytes and print length, magic, hex prefix - ``head -c 64 PATH | xxd``
xxd: - ``hexdump -C`` or short Python read.
hexdump: - ``xxd`` or Python ``open(path,'rb').read(64).hex()``.
sshpass without ssh: - Install client: ``apt-get update && DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y openssh-client`` then retry.
